mecanismes_causaux: The variables interact to produce fraud by younger accounts with less transaction history (Account_Age) having increased chances of abnormal transaction activity (Number_of_Transactions_Last_24H), which can be influenced by the location (Location) and device used (Device_Used). Fraudulent transactions in the past (Previous_Fraudulent_Transactions) also increase the likelihood of current fraud. Anomalous transaction amounts (Transaction_Amount) are another signal of fraud.
signaux_fraude: Key signals of fraud include abnormal transaction activity, previous fraudulent transactions, and anomalous transaction amounts.
recommandations: To improve detection, consider monitoring accounts with less transaction history more closely, analyzing transaction patterns based on location and device used, and setting up alerts for anomalous transaction amounts. Regularly reviewing past fraudulent transactions can also help in identifying potential future fraud.
vulnerabilites: Two exploitable vulnerabilities for fraudsters are accounts with little transaction history (Account_Age) and the use of devices that mimic normal transaction patterns (Device_Used).
